tags.name: His Majesty's Theatre
tags.description: Opened in 1906, this is the largest theatre in the Grampian region. Constructed of Kemnay and Tillyfourie granite, the building is renowned for its Neo-Renaissance exterior and well-preserved mixed Baroque/Jacobean interior.
